description: Source code for PostScript hinter global hinting management in FreeType, including functions for scaling widths, handling blue zones, and managing global hinting data.

methods.name: psh_globals_scale_widths
methods.description: Scales the widths and heights table based on the current scale multiplier.

methods.name: psh_blues_set_zones_0
methods.description: Inserts blue zones into the sorted zones table, maintaining order and handling overlaps.

methods.name: psh_blues_set_zones
methods.description: Reorders, sanitizes, and fuzz-expands blue zones from font data.

methods.name: psh_blues_scale_zones
methods.description: Rescales blue zones when device transform changes, adjusting for overshoot suppression.

methods.name: psh_calc_max_height
methods.description: Calculates maximum height among given blue zones.

methods.name: psh_blues_snap_stem
methods.description: Aligns stem top and bottom to blue zones for hinting.

methods.name: psh_globals_destroy
methods.description: Frees and resets global hinting data.

methods.name: psh_globals_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new global hinting structure from private font data.

methods.name: psh_globals_set_scale
methods.description: Sets scaling factors for global hinting and updates widths and blue zones accordingly.

methods.name: psh_globals_funcs_init
methods.description: Initializes function pointers for global hinting operations.
